stories.headline: CFTC Orders Futures Exchanges to End US Location Restrictions
stories.summary: Registered platforms have 30 days to eliminate state trader limits or explain non-compliance to market regulators.
stories.originalTitle: CFTC gives futures exchanges 30 days to drop domestic geographic restrictions

stories.headline: US Treasury blocks bank transfers to crypto exchange MEXC
stories.summary: FinCEN accused the exchange of processing $16 billion in transfers linked to sanctions evasion and cybercrime.
stories.originalTitle: Treasury orders US banks to stop transfers to MEXC over $16 billion in illicit transactions

stories.headline: Aztec Releases Tierra Upgrade to Fix Network Vulnerability
stories.summary: The update adds cryptographic verification and cuts Ethereum-to-Aztec message delivery to as little as 12 seconds.
stories.originalTitle: Aztec Launches Tierra Upgrade, Patching Critical Flaw in Privacy Network
